body.headline: Identifier screen: clean
body.message: The identifier screen read commit ffffffffffff, and main is now at 0123456789ab: its verdict is about content that has since changed. Re-run it with nemar admin publish screen nm000736. If an approval already started and committed to the repository, continue it with --resume instead.
